dct_description_sm: The Mackenzie Delta and the nearshore Beaufort Sea, which is very shallow and stratified, is a strongly linked estuary with flows from the Mackenzie Delta affecting currents, water density, water temperature, waves, and ice conditions in the nearshore Beaufort Sea. In addition, the Mackenzie River plume may reach several hundred kilometres into the coastal zone, influencing ocean currents, the marine habitat for fish and mammals, and the development of storms. With resource development expected in the Beaufort offshore region, there is need to implement an operational Ocean-Ice-Atmosphere (OIA) model that includes the Beaufort Sea. Such a model is needed by regulators and industry in order to plan and carry out sustainable development in this area. Therefore, the complex interactions of the Mackenzie Delta and Beaufort Sea must be considered, and this knowledge used in the development and implementation of a robust OIA model.
dct_title_s: Modelling of Freshwater Flows to the Beaufort Sea for Improved Offshore Prediction by the Metarea Ocean Forecast System
